caption:
A love story built to last for @bonnieclyde.

After a breakout moment propelled the brand beyond its cult following, the team at Bonnie Clyde tasked us to build an identity that could grow with it. Our research led us to Shakespeare: expansive enough to hold spectacle, play, and all the beautifully irrational things people do for love.

To bring that territory to life in the wordmark, we returned to the history of typography itself. We spent time at the Herb Lubalin Center, Cooper Union’s type archive, and The Rare Book Division at the New York Public Library. Through our studies, Lombardic capitals in medieval manuscripts and the Gutenberg Bible became referential starting points for Bonnie Clyde’s identity.

Countless iterations exploring flare, structure, sharpness and ornamentation, landed a final wordmark that preserves the drama of its historical bones, while feeling completely at home in fashion culture right now. 

More from our work with @bonnieclyde soon.

caption:
A new brand identity and strategic platform for @usenourish.

Nourish is taking health out of the optimization game by pairing people with registered dietitians and health experts who can help them reach their individual goals. As the rest of the world over-complicates and under-delivers, Nourish brings us back to the basics of being.

Together, we redefined what real care could look like in an increasingly digital world—then built a brand around it. From a symbol rooted in growth to a color palette with a pulse to an ecosystem that connects each part of the experience, every element aims to make health feel less clinical and more human. 

Our identity is rooted in a simple belief: better health isn’t about becoming someone else. It’s about returning to the everyday choices that bring our best self within reach.

caption:
Home ownership has been a defining milestone of our society for generations. But the smarter our homes become, the more there is to manage, maintain, and make sense of. Enter Casa.

The idea is simple: help the home tend to itself. Casa is a platform that uses intelligence to bring every aspect of home care together, from routine cleanings and replacement appliance parts to full-scale renovations and remodels. We worked with the team at Casa to create a brand world that puts our focus back where it belongs—on living.

Like many of our projects, that vision came to fruition in a careful balance between opposing forces. The identity is both warm and precise, featuring an almost primitive symbol paired with a slightly heavier-than-usual serif. Illustrations are equal parts functional and figurative, designed to feel more like pieces of art hung around the house. Nowhere is this balance more apparent than on the website, where Casa’s story, service, and spirit come together.

Making the ordinary aspirational. A perfect match for @casatechnologies: the company finding big and small ways to bring home back to life.
